title: api-gateway: tune streaming proxy buffers, routing rules, and payload limits (OpenAI compat)
author: Priya Singh
release_notes: Increase default streaming proxy buffer to 256KB, enforce 1MB payload cap for tool/function-calling requests, and route streaming requests to low-latency serving pools by default. OpenAI-compat layer: fix SSE framing for chunked streaming and make backpressure behavior more deterministic. Users exceeding new payload caps will receive 413 responses; operators can tune buffer/limit via helm values or env vars.
body: Summary: This PR tunes API gateway streaming behavior to reduce latency spikes and backend overloads observed in spike traffic. Changes include increasing the streaming proxy buffer size, updating routing rules so streaming requests prefer low-latency pools, and adding a conservative payload size cap for tool/function calling and structured output requests. It also includes fixes to the OpenAI compatibility layer to ensure chunk framing and 'stream: true' semantics produce stable SSE output. Motivation: Recent incidents (SUP-4128) and perf canary runs showed repeated streaming stalls and backend OOMs when very large tool-calls or improperly framed chunks arrived over the proxy. We need deterministic windowing at the gateway to protect serving pools while preserving developer API compatibility. Checklist: - [x] Increase default streaming proxy buffer to 256KB with tunable helm/env override - [x] Route streaming requests to low-latency routing pool by default (configurable) - [x] Enforce 1MB payload cap for tool/function-calling requests; return 413 if exceeded - [x] Fix OpenAI-compat streaming chunk framing and backpressure hooks - [x] Add unit/integration tests and e2e streaming test harness update - [x] Update docs: api/streaming.md + upgrade notes Breaking behavior/Compatibility notes: - Clients sending single-request payloads >1MB for function/tool calls will now get a 413. This was rare but caused most of the gateway backpressure; recommend splitting calls or using chunked streaming. - Streaming buffers are larger by default to reduce copy churn and syscalls; this increases memory headroom per connection slightly but reduces CPU spikes and improves throughput. - OpenAI compat: chunk framing is now stricter; mis-framed chunks that previously sometimes passed through will be rejected with a 400 (we include an upgrade note). Implementation details (high level): - gateway/proxy/stream_proxy.go: defaultProxyBuffer increased from 64KB to 256KB; buffer pool introduced to reduce alloc churn; metrics added (proxy_buffer_allocs, proxy_buffer_reuse). - gateway/router/routing_rules.go: new IsStreamingRequest helper determines streaming semantics (based on content-type, OpenAI-style "stream" flag, and websocket/SSE hints) and tags requests for low_latency route. - gateway/api/openai_compat.go: streaming SSE framing fixed (no trailing partial event), robust handling of function call tokens and tool invocation JSON boundaries; added backpressure signals so runtime yields earlier when connection write queues grow. - gateway/limits/payload_guard.go: enforcePayloadCap middleware added; default cap 1_048_576 bytes for tool/function calls; generic requests still use larger caps but are logged. - infra/helm/values.yaml & docs: expose proxy.buffer_size, routing.low_latency_pool, limits.tool_payload_bytes. Tests & CI: - unit tests for framing and payload guard added in sdk/ts/openai_compat_test.ts and gateway unit tests. - e2e streaming scenario added to perf-canary harness. - CI: initial run hit a flaky test in proxy buffer allocator (race), fixed with a small mutex and re-run. Final CI: all checks green. Migration & ops notes: - Operators can tune values in helm chart under gateway.proxy.buffer_size and gateway.limits.tool_payload_bytes. We added a feature flag (GATEWAY_STREAMING_TUNE) to gate rollout. - Recommend canary rollout to dedicated low-latency pool for 24h before global switch. Monitoring: - Added metrics: gateway.proxy.buffer_size_bytes, gateway.proxy.active_buffers, gateway.limits.rejected_tool_calls_count. - Alerts: SLO: increased 95p latency alert if proxy buffers get exhausted 3x/min for 5min. Related: SUP-4128, ENG-7842, PM-231.

files_changed: gateway/proxy/stream_proxy.go - increased default buffer from 64*1024 to 256*1024; added sync.Pool for buffers; added metrics for buffer reuse
gateway/router/routing_rules.go - new IsStreamingRequest(req) helper; routing policy updated to prefer 'low_latency' pool for streaming; added unit tests
gateway/api/openai_compat.go - stricter SSE chunk framing; ensure final event closure; handle partial json boundaries for function/tool calls
gateway/limits/payload_guard.go - new middleware enforcing 1MB cap on tool/function-calling bodies; returns 413 with diagnostic header X-Redwood-Reason
infra/helm/values.yaml - add gateway.proxy.buffer_size and gateway.limits.tool_payload_bytes values
sdk/ts/openai_compat_test.ts - added tests for chunk framing and large payload rejection
docs/api/streaming.md - documented new defaults, upgrade notes, mitigation strategies for clients
perf-canary/scenarios/streaming_backpressure.yaml - added a workload to validate buffer changes under burst traffic
